column1: # DS3 bosses: defeat flag, area, required/optional, note, fight flags, phase flags. No names here: the app shows the name the game puts on
#   the boss's health bar, read from the user's own install (generated/boss_names.tsv).
# Flag: the boss's defeat event flag (ids credited in data/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; 14000800 verified flipping live).
# Area: where the boss stands in the game's map files (its enemy parts, entity flag - 10,000,000 + 0..9), by
#   data/region_areas.tsv. The real-data suite checks it equals what the game's files give.
# Status: required / optional (DLC bosses within their DLC). Checked against our own route (data/route.tsv, clean-data
#   step 5.4): a boss that gates a main or DLC step must be required, every boss of an optional step optional
#   (data test data_route_is_consistent). The ends of each part (Soul of Cinder, Sister Friede, Slave Knight Gael)
#   are required; Curse-rotted Greatwood is optional though its area is on the main path.
# Note: the DLC the boss belongs to, from its map (m45 Ashes of Ariandel; m50, m51 The Ringed City). The app counts
#   DLC bosses apart by the "DLC" in it.
# Fight: event flags, any of which is set while the boss's fight is on: the game's own event that shows the boss's
#   health bar sets it: its event id, set when the event ends right after the bar, where no path through the event
#   can end before the bar (other than when the boss is defeated or the player is a phantom); else a flag set right
#   after the bar (Dancer's event can end early another way; Wolnir's two events each end on whether he's been
#   fought before). Map-local temporary flags (thousands digit 5), so the game clears them when the map reloads after
#   a death. 14005810 verified live: on as the bar appeared, off at each death. A death while a fight is on is an
#   attempt at that boss.
# Phases: one flag per phase after the first, in order, each set by the event where that phase begins (a health-bar
#   or AI-signal event; temporary too). The phase is 1 + the position of the last one set. 14005802 verified live (Iudex
#   Gundyr's second phase). The real-data suite checks every fight and phase flag against the game's event scripts.
